home.title: Compare markets for your crop
home.subtitle: See the latest reported mandi prices near your district and the money that may be left after estimated transport.
home.sum_title: How the estimate is worked out
about.title: About the prices
about.source: The latest mandi prices reported by the Government of India (DMI) on data.gov.in. They are not minute-by-minute prices.
about.freshness: Every price shows its report date and how fresh it is:
about.transport: Transport is an estimate you can change.
net.label: Estimated net realization
transport.label: Estimated — based on ₹{rate}/km assumption. Actual costs will vary.
transport.bar_caption: Estimated transport, on one scale for all markets (₹0 to ₹{max})
answer.title: Recommended: {market}
answer.net: ≈₹{net} estimated net realization — money left after estimated transport
rank.basis: Ranked mainly by estimated net realization, also weighing price, trend, data freshness and transport.
rank.basis_whatif: Ranked by estimated net realization only.
callout.title: Why the highest price is not ranked first
callout.more: {P} has the highest price (₹{price}/quintal), but after estimated transport {R} may leave about ₹{n} more.
callout.not_more: {P} has the highest price and about ₹{n} more estimated net realization, but {R} is ranked first because the ranking also weighs price trend, data freshness and transport.
callout.equal: {P} has the highest price and the same estimated net realization, but {R} is ranked first because the ranking also weighs price trend, data freshness and transport.
callout.arith_less: +₹{gross} from the higher price · −₹{transport} more estimated transport = ₹{n} less at {P}
callout.arith_more: +₹{gross} from the higher price · −₹{transport} more estimated transport = ₹{n} more at {P}
reason.PRICE_ADVANTAGE: Higher price than most markets here
state.outage: Latest source synchronization is unavailable. Showing most recently stored government-reported data.

state.no_recent: No recent market observation available for this commodity in your area.
state.insufficient_history: Insufficient historical data for this market/commodity
state.never_synced: AgriNex has not received government prices yet.
state.stale_note: These prices are old. They may have changed since they were reported.
whatif.banner: What-if — hypothetical. Reported prices are unchanged. Nothing is saved. Ranked by estimated net realization only.
disclaimer: Market prices, transport estimates, and forecasts may be incomplete, delayed, revised, or different from actual transaction conditions. AgriNex provides decision-support information and does not guarantee a sale price, transport quote, profit, or future market movement.
